name: Alerts: new contact messages and sign-ups

parameters.jsCode:
const s = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
return [{ json: { lastMsg: s.lastMsg ?? 0, lastUser: s.lastUser ?? 0 } }];

parameters.query:
SELECT 'cursor' AS kind, NULL::bigint AS id, NULL::text AS name, NULL::text AS email, NULL::text AS body, now() AS created_at,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(id), 0) FROM contact_messages)::bigint AS max_msg,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(id), 0) FROM users)::bigint AS max_user
UNION ALL
SELECT 'message', id, name::text, email::text, left(message, 700), created_at, NULL, NULL
  FROM contact_messages WHERE id > $1::bigint
UNION ALL
SELECT 'signup', id, coalesce(name, '')::text, email::text, NULL, created_at, NULL, NULL
  FROM users WHERE id > $2::bigint
ORDER BY created_at
LIMIT 60
